notes.title: Mega improvements and upgrade v.0.0.26
notes.notes:
[p]The world of LIFE EFFECT welcomes you. I am pleased to report on the great work that has been done, which has solved many problems and improved the gameplay. This is not the end, there are still some points to be completed, but I left them for the next update, as it will take time, and I want you to play with these innovations already.[/p][p]✅The character's interaction system with interactive objects has been almost completely redesigned. Now, to apply an action, for example: open a door, a chest, press a button, talk to an NPC, open a companion menu, and so on, you need to point the center of the screen at an object and it will light up. Now there won't be any problems like before that we couldn't open the chests when there are more chests or your pets nearby. The redesign of the interaction system made it possible to reduce the code, eliminate some bugs and improve optimization. It remains to implement the system in the mechanics of cars and personal equipment, drones, turrets and robots. Picking up items and quest items will remain the same in the sphere, since I think you will get tired of pointing the center of the screen at each item to pick it up, I think it will be easier to go up and press the usual F button to pick it up.[/p][p]✅A button has been added to the quest menu to scan the inventory to find items required in quests. Launching the button scans your entire inventory and runs through the entire active list of quests, if the required items are found, a notification will appear on the screen.[/p][p]✅The time spent by your corpse on the location has been increased, Survival difficulty is 60 minutes, Adventure difficulty is 30 minutes.[/p][p]✅Fixed disabling the visibility of equipment, previously, if we disabled the visibility of weapons in the equipment menu, and at the same time picked up a weapon, and then put it behind our back, it became visible.[/p][p]✅Accelerated weapon change by 30%[/p][p]✅Fixed a bug where by closing the weapon switch buttons, it was possible to get two guns in your hand at once, and then the game crashed/hung up or the character started endlessly putting on and putting away weapons without stopping.[/p][p]✅I have slightly changed the operation of the quick access slots (F1 - F10) when using weapons. I made sure that if there is no weapon in my hand, and press the F slot (for example, there is another gun in this slot), then he will simply replace the weapon on his back, and if the weapon was in his hand and press the F slot, then the character will put the weapon behind his back, replace it, and immediately pick it up, it should be convenient.[/p][p]✅The "Attack Preparation" option has been added to the game settings. Disabled option: The character has a weapon in his hands and you use food, water, a first aid kit or other recovery items, then the character puts the weapon behind his back, uses this item and the weapon remains behind his back, you will need to press the button to pick up the right weapon again. If the parameter is enabled, then the character will return the weapon to his hands after using the item.[/p][p]✅Fixed a bug where the character could stop aiming (pressing the right mouse button).[/p][p]Now the ASH-12 MOD has 20 ammo in its magazine (it had 10), and the ASH-12 Bonecrusher has 30 ammo (it had 20).[/p][p]✅Merchants have increased the amount of money to purchase items from you.[/p][p]✅Fixed the error of calculating money for the sale of items from the jewelry category. If you sell through the inventory by right-clicking (without dragging the item into the merchant's window), then 30% is deducted from the cost as from the usual ones. Jewelry categories should be sold to the merchant at 100% of the cost as indicated in the information window if you click on the item icon.[/p][p]✅Fixed the operation of stationary location scanners, which you can find at locations and launch it to get a map image.[/p][p]✅The Black Widow mercenary has been promoted, now she is rank 5.[/p][p]✅Automatic drones have been edited: FL2, J2, D100, S300, X5, RA700, G2, G3, G4, R1000 and D3. Now they will not be destroyed when the player dies, and the height of the flight behind the character has been edited.[/p][p]✅The G4 drone will no longer fire missiles if your character is close to the enemy the drone is aiming at. The rocket's flight speed has been increased.[/p][p]✅Fixed the interaction of RPG missile damage.[/p][p]✅The LG09 robot's guided missile code has been improved.[/p][p]✅Now all the equipment, namely drones, turrets, robots and so on, if it is destroyed, then when buying a new one there will always be full health, ammunition and battery.
[/p][previewyoutube="lAHu-ip3nrg;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Map and mini map v.0.0.25
notes.notes:
[p]The world of LIFE EFFECT welcomes you. By popular request, players have created a map in the game, and a mini-map in the corner of the screen. The mechanics of map drawing remain in the game for those who wish to explore the world in a more sophisticated style. The map should be enabled by default in the game settings, but if for some reason it is disabled for players who are already playing the game, go to settings and enable it. Therefore, at each location you will have to find an installation from which the survivors receive location data for the map. The installation needs to be started and the map will be displayed. If you have not scanned the location with the installation, and you have found some important places on the location, the labels of these places will immediately be displayed and saved. An item has been added to the game, a mobile location scanning unit, you can buy it from an equipment dealer. Use it in your inventory to install it on a location, it communicates with the main installation remotely, and you can download the map data.[/p][p]✅Added a map[/p][p]✅The ability to disable the map, damage figures, and change the style of the mini-map has been added to the game settings.[/p][p]✅The ability to disable the display of icons in the world has been added to the game settings.[/p][p]✅Scanning grenades now give a buff for 60 seconds, which means that enemies and resources will be displayed on the map during this time.[/p][p]✅The map will display markings of the entrances and exits of the location, or the location of important places if you have found them.[/p][p]✅The quest label is displayed on the map. Greetings to all dear friends, gamers and observers, several new mechanics and changes have been added to the game, which must be told about.


Items have been added to create control points in the form of a tent or sleeping bag, in the future it will be possible to go to bed in a tent to skip the night. The tents have a storage of a certain number of slots, in which you can temporarily put items. Tents are preserved in the world, you can place them in dangerous places so that you have the nearest resurrection point. If you put the items in the tent, and click take the tent to inventory, then all the items in it will fall out of it to the ground. Tents have durability, so it is desirable to install it in a safe place so that enemies do not notice it and destroy it. Recreation items will be available in crafting, selling and farming.


Important mechanics that will significantly help you in storing a large number of items are cases. There are many different cases with different number of slots for items, with the help of them you can make caches of items anywhere in the world, or make a warehouse in your personal bunker, and the most important thing is the tactical creation of a cache before a raid of enemy bases or dangerous parts of the world. The system of storing items is the same as in tents, if there are items in the case and you take it to the inventory, then the items fall out. There are special cases in which alien technologies are added, such as a spatial module, this case allows you to store items with the possibility of carrying a case, that is, items do not fall out of it, so you can reduce the weight carried by the character and have much more items with you, especially if you went on a raid or a trip.


The gameplay component has been improved in the game, which will allow you to enjoy the game even more. Visual effects have been added and the character's interaction with the world has been simplified.

Items that we can create in crafting are now available for disassembly for spare parts, and not only those items from the crafting list, but also extracted items from the world, such as equipment, drones, weapons, devices and resources. Thus, the weapons or equipment that we are tired of when parsing will give us a second chance to take these spare parts and create another similar equipment or weapons of this series. Disassembling objects has a small chance of damaging parts, as a result of which we may lose
several parts.

2. Added quick access slots for instant use of items, this will allow you to activate equipment, drones and other items without opening inventory. Quick Access slots allow you to quickly react to the use of items in combat or important and dangerous events in the game. Now if you hold an item in the inventory with the left mouse button and start transferring it, all slots where this item can be installed will be highlighted to facilitate equipment, as well as already equipped items in the inventory will be highlighted for instant visual detection.

3. Added the ability to pick up items by clicking the left mouse button on the icon, previously we could pick up items only in a radius around the character, or if there are a lot of items, and for example we don't need to pick up everything, but only the right ones, then it was a little uncomfortable, now with a large amount of loot in one place, we easily choose the items that we need.

4. The first items have been added to strengthen the companion, depending on the characteristics of the injection or the food item, you can increase the characteristics of the creature forever, it can be strength, food, water, health and in the future new added parameters. The companions have added a scale of water consumption, previously there was only food and health. It is planned to add items to strengthen not only the companions, but also the character himself.

5. Earlier in the game development reviews, I showed an enemy scanning system, with which you can find out the parameters of the enemy's strength, health, as well as his weaknesses and a list of items that can be obtained from him, now the ability to scan resources and add them to the database has been added. This way we will be able to know exactly what items are extracted from the resource, its description and characteristics.

6. The corpse of the character now gives you the opportunity to pick up your lost inventory items at death. When a character dies, the entire inventory is transferred to the corpse, you have an hour to return and pick up your things. If a long time passes, only bones remain from the corpse, and after a while it dissolves, and objects will no longer be able to be picked up. Therefore, if a character died among a crowd of monsters and you do not have the opportunity to pick up inventory items, you can go to the base or a cache that will arm itself and recapture things, the corpse is preserved.

notes.title: Growing and creating companion pets.
notes.notes:
In this update, a laboratory item has been added, an installation for creating and processing biological bodies, such as monster eggs and newly born cubs.
The installation will help the player to create his own personal companion friend who will accompany you and protect you.
The installation has three compartments for certain processing, one of them works with eggs, helps to create an environment for successful maturation and subsequent hatching, after which the cub, seeing you for the first time, will assume that you are his parent and will not show aggression. The second compartment is designed for cubs that have already been born naturally, such cubs already know who their parent is and will consider all non-their kind enemies. The player will have the opportunity to steal the cub from the nesting sites, after placing it in an incubator, it will be possible to sew a nano chip into his brain and make the cub think that you are his friend. The third compartment with mechanized installations can create a full-fledged cyborg or companion robot for you, but for this you will need to get a core or a digital media with the data of the drawings for creation.

Pets are designed to support the player in difficult areas on locations, for example, storming military bases or aliens, mopping up breeding grounds of monsters and mutants, eliminating elite enemies and bosses, and of course protecting personal territories.

Growing a companion is a long process, in addition to the time of hatching, it also needs to be raised until adolescence, after which it will receive the ability to attack, and until that moment the cub must be carefully monitored, left in safe places, fed with food.
Pumping parameters occurs with each event, the first generation of the starting parameters occurs at hatching or creation, then the parameters grow in place with the growth of the pet, the next increase occurs when pumping the pet level, and there are still bonus accruals of parameters, absolutely all accruals are random, you will never be able to create a pet with the same stats, there will always be someone stronger in damage, and weaker in health or turnover, but there are chances to grow a balanced one.
In the future, it is planned to add injection items to the game and enhance the companion with nanotechnology.
And there is also an opportunity to get a legendary cub or egg with a small chance when killing a boss of this kind, this pet will visually stand out with effects among the rest of your pets, its parameters will of course be several times higher than the standard, it will also have additional abilities.

Pets have several types of the original form of infection, habitats determine what kind of pet will have and what skills, for example, if the nesting place was in a cave with fire crystals, then mutants there have the power of fire and the ability to control the energy of fire. While there are three types of crystal energy in the game - fire, acid and plasma, if a pet has one of these energies, then it gives him full immunity to damage from it. Thus, in some situations, you will need to think over your strategy of attacking the enemy if he has one of these infection energies.

This is 1 of 6 conceived mechanics for obtaining and creating personal friends of companions, we will talk about the rest of the possibilities later.

notes.notes:
1. Added 10 robots with different types of weapons and mechanics. These robots have two types of movement bases, the first tracked and with mechanisms in the form of spider legs.
Enemy robots will be twice as large in size, destroying them the player will have a chance to get spare parts for crafting their own robot of each type.

2. Added 50 items for farming, crafting and trading.

3. Work has been carried out on optimizing new robots and effects.

This robotics will be used by the alien faction, the military and the player himself. Spawn sites will be designated later, but the task of robots is the defense of fortifications and patrol areas.
Work is underway on other mechanics and features of the game, work on locations, dungeons and bases. Video reviews with information about the progress of the development of mechanics will be published in the news, in the discord community and on the YouTube channel.
